Appendix table 5. Adults under community supervision, 2023

column16: Number under community supervision per 100,000 adult residents, December 31, 2023/c

column1: Note: Counts were rounded to the nearest 100. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding. Due to nonresponse or incomplete data, the community supervision population for some jurisdictions on December 31, 2023, does not equal the population on January 1, 2023, plus entries, minus exits. Data from 2023 are not comparable to prior years. Reporting methods for some probation agencies changed over time and probation coverage was expanded in 2023.

a/The January 1 population excludes 20,881 offenders and the December 31 population excludes 11,785 offenders under community supervision who were on both probation and parole. See Methodology for more detail on dual status.
b/Reflects reported data except for jurisdictions in which data were not available.
c/Rates were computed using the estimated U.S. adult resident population in each jurisdiction on January 1, 2023.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey and Annual Parole Survey, 2023; and U.S. Census Bureau, National Intercensal Estimates, 2024.
